decisions.reason: Matrix columns equal GEO titles (179/179). Title code = tissue prefix + C/P/A (Control/LP/LPA) + S/E (Sed/Ex) + animal number; codes agree with the treatment and activity characteristics. Tissue-identity check (Spearman correlation of each sample to per-tissue median log2CPM): L_AE7 is colon and L_PE4 is muscle although labelled liver; both are excluded as mislabelled before any model (paper reports n=4-6/group, consistent with exclusions). L_AE11 is liver with a colon component (r 0.94 to liver, 0.75 to colon); kept in the paper-aligned run and dropped in a sensitivity run (qc column).

Paper design ~group per tissue with LPAEx as comparator. Exercise-only simple effects within CON and LP (CONEx vs CONSed, LPEx vs LPSed) are not reported by the paper and run as exploratory from the same fit.
Each tissue is fitted separately with one sample per animal, so no repeated measures within a model. No batch/lane variable recorded; paper adjusts for none.

deviations: pydeseq2 rather than R DESeq2; pre-filtering not stated by paper, none applied

caveats: Paper reports n=4-6/group; deposited data have 6/group per tissue (liver LPEx 5).
Only LPAEx vs LPASed isolates exercise among the paper's contrasts; LPAEx vs CONSed/LPSed mixes probiotic and exercise.
Paper counts for most hippocampus/colon/muscle comparisons are only in supplementary tables (stated as 2-14).
PFC_AE9, PFC_CS7 and HippoPS7 correlate slightly better with the other brain region; PFC and hippocampus are similar, so not treated as mislabelled.

Deposited liver columns L_AE7/GSM6591471 (colon) and L_PE4/GSM6591458 (muscle) are mislabelled and excluded; with them excluded the liver counts match the paper (paper probably excluded them too: n=4-6).

Liver LPAEx contrasts depend on L_AE11 (GSM6591473), which carries colon contamination: without it LPAEx vs LPASed drops from 97 to 6 DEGs and the other LPAEx contrasts to 2-13. The paper's liver 'inflammation' signature of LPAEx is therefore not robust to this sample.
Gene-level checks by symbol are not possible: the matrix has Ensembl IDs only, and the paper's named genes are symbols.

decisions.reason: Paper's contrasts reproduced with its method and threshold.
